notes: EDGE CASE: teaser blast that deliberately withholds the exact address ('a townhouse in the West 70s') to protect the seller pre-market. There is no street number anywhere, so expected.address is null (non-hallucination assertion) - the extractor must NOT invent a street number. Neighborhood and price are stated, so those are graded. Lower confidence floor for the vague identity.

input.subject: Coming soon (address on request) - UWS townhouse in the West 70s
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Discreet coming soon - seller does not want the address circulating yet, so I'm keeping it off the blast for now.

What I can share:
- Single-family townhouse in the West 70s, just off Central Park West
- Upper West Side
- 20-ft wide, 4 stories + garden level
- 6BR / 4.5BA, owner's triplex over a garden rental
- Asking in the low $8Ms - call me for the exact number and address
- Coming to market late August

If you have a serious townhouse buyer in this range, reply and I'll share the full package under NDA. Co-broke of course.

Gabriel Stein
Douglas Elliman
917 555 0126
